metadata.description: Learning Paths for Pool OS Knowledge Base

complete_beginner.name: Complete Beginner
complete_beginner.description: For absolute beginners with no prior pool experience

phases.title: Introduction to Pool
milestones: Bridge hand is stable and level
completionCriteria: Can pocket 10 straight shots in a row from 3 feet
No tension in stance or grip

phases.title: Basic Aiming
completionCriteria: Can pocket 8/10 center ball shots from 4 feet
Can make half-ball shots 6/10 from 3 feet
Aim is consistent left and right

phases.title: Cut Shots
milestones: Can judge thick vs thin cuts
completionCriteria: Can adjust aim for different cut angles

phases.title: Basic Cue Ball Control
phases.titleVi: Kiểm soát bi trắng cơ bản

knowledgeOrder.title: Stop Ball
knowledgeOrder.focus: Cue ball stops at object ball

phases.title: Basic Safety Play
completionCriteria: Leaves opponent tough shot after safety

H_to_G.name: H → G: Developing Consistency
H_to_G.description: For H-level players ready to develop consistent game

phases.title: Stroke Refinement
milestones: Can control speed from soft to medium
completionCriteria: Can complete 50 consecutive shots without error

phases.title: Position Play Introduction
completionCriteria: Can run 5 balls with position 5/10 attempts
Cue ball lands within 1 ball width of target

phases.title: Run Out Development
completionCriteria: Knows when to safety vs run

phases.title: Mental Game Basics
milestones: Can maintain focus during run outs
completionCriteria: No significant performance drop after miss
Can complete practice session without frustration

G_to_F.name: G → F: Club Player Development
G_to_F.description: For G-level players aiming for club-level competition

phases.title: Advanced Cue Ball Control
phases.titleVi: Kiểm soát bi trắng nâng cao
milestones: Combines spin with speed and cut
completionCriteria: Can predict spin behavior after 1 rail

F_to_E.name: F → E: Advanced Player
F_to_E.description: For F-level club players aiming for advanced competition

phases.title: Massé & Advanced Shots
phases.titleVi: Massé và kỹ thuật cao cấp

E_to_D.name: E → D: Tournament Contender
E_to_D.description: For E-level players aiming for semi-professional competition

phases.title: Speed Mastery
milestones: Soft shots are delicate and accurate

phases.title: Cue Ball Mastery
completionCriteria: Can recover from any position error
Has professional-level skills in most areas

D_to_C.name: D → C: Professional Development
D_to_C.description: For D-level semi-pros aiming for professional competition

phases.title: Professional Mental Game
completionCriteria: Can identify and fix any issue

safety_specialist.name: Safety Specialist Path
safety_specialist.nameVi: Lộ trình Chuyên gia An toàn
safety_specialist.description: For players wanting to develop elite safety and defensive play
completionCriteria: Can beat better players with defense

position_specialist.name: Position Specialist Path
position_specialist.nameVi: Lộ trình Chuyên gia Vị trí
position_specialist.description: For players wanting to develop elite position play

breaking_specialist.name: Breaking Specialist Path
breaking_specialist.description: For players wanting to develop elite break shots

tournament_player.description: Complete path for competitive tournament players
